Reusable structure shared by all Arcadia elements.
Used to annotate the top-level element of an Arcadia model and its engineering perspective packages (OA, SA, LA, PA, EPBS)
flag to indicate which engineering perspective you're in.
A generic Arcadia component, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.

A Physical Architecture component of Node nature: a physical platform that hosts deployed components,
		 * Behavior Components or Node Components (see Deployment). The actors of the Physical Architecture are Node Components.

A Physical Architecture component of Behavior nature: it carries allocated functions and component exchanges,
		 * and is deployed on a Node Component, not contained in it (see Deployment).

A generic Arcadia Deployment, used in the Physical Architecture: a component (deployedElement) is deployed on
		 * another component (location), instead of being contained in it. Typically a Behavior Component or a Node Component
		 * is deployed on a Node Component.
		 * A Deployment is stored in the location component, and is written
		 * 'allocation : Deployment allocate <deployed component> to self;'.
A generic Arcadia Component Port, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.

A generic Component Exchange, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.
    	 * Functional Exchanges are allocated to a Component Exchange with ExchangeAllocation usages
    	 * (see ExchangeAllocation); the list of allocated Functional Exchanges is derived by tooling.
A  generic Arcadia Function, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.
A  generic Arcadia Functional Chain, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.
A generic Arcadia Functional Exchange, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.

A generic Arcadia Exchange Allocation, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.
	     * An Exchange Allocation is owned by the Component Exchange it allocates to, and is written
	     * 'allocation : ExchangeAllocation allocate <functional exchange> to self;'.

A generic Arcadia Realization, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives and for all kinds of
	     * Arcadia elements: an element (realizing) realizes an element of the previous engineering perspective (realized).
	     * A Realization is owned by the realizing element, and is written
	     * 'allocation : Realization allocate <realized element> to self;'.
	     * The 'realizes' and 'is realized by' navigations are derived by tooling and are not stored.
A generic Arcadia ExchangeItem, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.
A generic Arcadia Capability, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.
A generic Arcadia Mission, used across all Arcadia engineering perspectives.
